Uniformly accelerated motion happens when an object experiences a constant rate of acceleration.

In this type of motion, the object’s speed changes evenly over time either speeding up or slowing down like a car steadily increasing its speed or an object falling under gravity.
A cyclist starts at a speed of 5 m/s and accelerates at 1.5 m/s² for 8 seconds. What is the final velocity of the cyclist?

Given:
		u = 5 m/s
		a = 1.5 m/s²
		t = 8 seconds
		v = ?

Where:
		v = Final Velocity (m/s)
		u = Initial Velocity (m/s)
		a = Acceleration (m/s²)
		t = Time (seconds)
